description: Patient questionnaire report bundled template. Used for both efficacy and adherence themes; the dynamic result-section block is cloned per payload.result_sections length so theme-specific section counts adapt without a separate template.
notes: Task 5 inserted six {{field.*}} placeholders in cover-page metadata, settlement page service block, sample-collection range/count, and footer date. The same placeholder is allowed to appear multiple times (e.g. {{field.service.unit}} occurs on the cover page and the settlement page); they are therefore listed under field_placeholders rather than required_singletons. Preflight uses field_placeholders only to whitelist their kind/path so {{...}} tokens that don't match any declared name still trigger INVALID_PLACEHOLDER.
required_singletons remains the contract for placeholders that must appear exactly once (block / repeat anchors inserted by Tasks 6-8).
allowed_chart_modes captures the locked-in answer to spec Q3: chapter-4 result-overview charts are PNG drawings (two), section 5.1 key-issue charts are native Office 3D pie drawings (two).
